desc: Benelli's M4 has earned its legendary reputation as one of the finest semi-auto shotguns in the world, used by law enforcement and military professionals for years. But even one of the world's best shotguns could be made better with some upgrades. To that end, Midwest Industries designed the Benelli M4 Enhanced Charging Handle. Compatible with the Benelli M4 and clones, this charging handle features a knurled surface which gives you a more solid grip, which means you can more effectively operate your shotgun!
